title: Filipinos bag 6 medals at Toyota Asia Pacific Skills Contest
summary: Toyota Motor Philippines Corporation (TMP) brought home a landmark win for the Philippines after its Filipino delegation earned six medals across all categories in the Toyota 2026 Asia Pacific Skills…
